prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (70% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.3 °C (59% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.8 °C (51% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.34 l/min (4% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 375 W·min/l (2% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.6 % (within 2% of healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.4 bar (3% below healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
